(Currently amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer.
